name: net_issuance (iss_rank)
economic_meaning: Net share-issuance anomaly (Pontiff-Woodgate, Daniel-Titman): firms REDUCING share count (buybacks) outperform; firms ISSUING shares (dilution, often when overvalued / empire-building) underperform. Signal = -rank(1-year change in shares outstanding).
checks: 5/8 - CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT PASS, LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE PASS, turnover PASS, matches-comp PASS, self-corr pending. (LOW_SHARPE/FITNESS below competition bar - this is a diversifier, not a 2.0 alpha)
design: SIMPLE (1 field: sharesout). REGULARIZED via rank() - spreads the lumpy buyback/issuance weights, fixing the concentration that the raw signal (SH 1.01 but conc-FAIL) had. ECONOMIC (issuance anomaly). DISTINCT - orthogonal mechanism to the value/reversal/sentiment mega (different driver: corporate financing).
tradeoff: Raw issuance rate: SH 1.01, FIT 1.51, ret 28%, TO 0.02 but FAILS concentration (lumpy). Rank-regularized: SH 0.52 but ALL structural gates pass + decay-stable (0.52 across decay 6/10, MARKET/IND/SUBIND). Rank trades strength for robustness. A softer regularizer (signed_power 0.5 / winsorize std=2) could retain ~0.7-0.8 while passing concentration.

regularization_spectrum.signed_power_0.5 (KPk7Rrzg): SH 1.01, FIT 1.64, ret 33%, TO 0.02 - BEST economics, but CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT + sub-universe FAIL (edge in extreme names)
regularization_spectrum.winsorize_std1 (wpLjVk21): SH 0.88 - still conc FAIL (aggressive clip insufficient)
regularization_spectrum.signed_power(winsorize_std2) (O0o7vXRp): SH 0.73, CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT PASS but sub-universe FAIL
regularization_spectrum.full_rank (ZYr7G5J8): SH 0.52 - the ONLY version passing ALL structural gates (conc+sub+turnover)

conclusion_A: Softer regularization (signed_power 0.5) retains the strong economics (SH 1.01, FIT 1.64, 33% return) but CANNOT pass concentration standalone - net-issuance's predictive power is intrinsically in the extreme buyback/issuance names (concentrated) and less-liquid names (weak sub-universe). Two usable forms: (1) full-rank SH 0.52 as a clean all-gates-pass standalone diversifier; (2) signed_power(0.5) SH 1.01 as a PORTFOLIO COMPONENT added to the mega, where its concentration dilutes in combination and it contributes strong orthogonal return.

recommended_for_combination.note: soft-regularized; use as orthogonal add-on to the mega (concentration dilutes in combo)
